KUBECTL_VERSION.description: Specific version of kubectl to install. Can be a numeric version or an alias.

KUBECTL_INSTALL_METHOD.description: Installation strategy for kubectl: 'libscript_native' installs into isolated versioned directories and 'system' delegates to the host OS package manager.

LIBSCRIPT_LISTEN_SOCKET.description: Global unix socket to listen on

KUBECTL_LISTEN_PORT.description: Port for KUBECTL to listen on

KUBECTL_LISTEN_ADDRESS.description: Address for KUBECTL to listen on

KUBECTL_LISTEN_SOCKET.description: Unix socket for KUBECTL to listen on

KUBECTL_DOWNLOAD_URL.description: Override URL for downloading kubectl binary or archive artifacts.

KUBECTL_ENABLED.description: Flag (0 or 1) indicating whether kubectl is enabled in the execution plan.
